rules: b_work/step1/schema.md v1.1 Section 4; b_work/step1/labeling_guide.md v1.1 Section 1.1
evidence_reference: Each evidence item is [document title, sentence index], as in supporting_facts. build_gold.py converts it to an evidence ID.
title_assumption: Evidence is shown together with its document title, as in HotpotQA. A sentence whose subject is the article's topic ('He won...', 'The team was created...') stands alone. Sentences that need an earlier sentence for other content ('The pair...', sentence fragments) are cited together with it.

notes: Multipart: both units necessary, no dependencies.
Debug only: two gold paraphrases, no distractors (review note Q11).

units.description: launch date of Voyager 1
date of Voyager 1's closest approach to Jupiter

notes: Multipart: both units necessary, no dependencies.

u2 is the UT date: closest approach was Aug. 25, 1989, 03:56 UT, which is Aug. 24 in US time zones. No 'August 24, 1989' alias (review note Q12 suggested one), because the only evidence sentence states August 25 and an alias would be accepted as correct while being CONTRADICTED by that evidence.

units.description: launch date of Voyager 2
date of Voyager 2's Neptune flyby

notes: Bridge: u1 finds the co-creator, u2 confirms the nickname.

notes: Comparison: two fact units plus a conclusion unit.

notes: Comparison (yes/no): two fact units plus a conclusion unit.

u2 uses the omission exception (labeling_guide.md 1.1, Exception 2): the defining description lists 'film director and producer'. The Jericho documents call him an executive producer, not a writer, so condition 4 holds.
This replaces the phrasing suggested in review note Q16, which predates the omission rule.
Open point: 'no' follows from u2 alone, but schema.md 4.3 makes the conclusion depend on both fact units.

units.description: whether William Kronick is a television writer
whether Jon Turteltaub is a television writer
whether William Kronick and Jon Turteltaub are both television writers

notes: Pending labeling_guide.md Section 5: answers that rely on the question's presupposition.
Drafted option: the conclusion depends only on Elytis's win and relies on the presupposition that exactly one of the two won.
No unit for 'Nin did not win': Exception 2 does not cover awards, so it would have support_sets [] and block the conclusion forever.
Anaïs Nin sentence 0 and Odysseas Elytis sentence 0 from the source supporting facts are not used. Elytis sentence 1 ('In 1979 he was awarded...') resolves 'he' through the document title.

units.description: whether Odysseas Elytis was awarded the Nobel Prize in Literature
which of Anaïs Nin and Odysseas Elytis was awarded the Nobel Prize in Literature

notes: Bridge: the film year (optional) then the earlier job (necessary).
Answer normalized from 'former Speaker of the U.S. House of Representatives'; aliases per review note Q18.
'U.S. Representative' is a second valid answer (Joseph Gaylord sentence 0), not a surface form. It is listed in aliases until the schema has a field for alternative answers.

Alternative support sets from review note Q18. Congressional Review Act 0-1 and Winning the Future 0-1 date the role (1996, 2005); the other sets say 'former' without a date, as does the source gold (Callista Gingrich sentence 1).
Political positions of Newt Gingrich sentence 0 ('including as Speaker of the House') added after the trace audit (2026-10-23): it states the role as explicitly as the undated sets.

units.description: year Newt Gingrich produced Nine Days that Changed the World
support_sets: Nine Days that Changed the World

units.description: job Newt Gingrich held before {u1}
units.expected_answer: Speaker of the U.S. House of Representatives

notes: Comparison (yes/no): two fact units plus a conclusion unit.
Osbeckia octandra and Osbeckia aspera sentence 0 explicitly name the genus Osbeckia and its family, so they are alternative support for u2.
The Gordonia species sentences and Osbeckia stellata do not mention the genus; linking a species to its genus by name is an inference, so they are excluded. This narrows review note Q19.

Strict exclusion kept after the trace audit (2026-10-23): Osbeckia stellata sentence 0 arrives in batch 1 of split traces, so a model that answers from it is scored unsupported. This is an intended hard case.
Trap: Gondysia similis ('Gordonia Darkwing') is a moth in Noctuidae.

units.description: family of the genus Gordonia
family of the genus Osbeckia
whether Gordonia and Osbeckia are in the same family
